_comment: Capability-root manifest for network/ (ADR-0562). Every crate, capability file path, fixture path, contract path, OpenSLO path, and accounting count below was read off the tree at authoring time, not transcribed from legacy cloud/cloud-network, cloud/cloud-network-dns, crates/oya-cloud-network-*, or microservices/ dump paths.
_tier_source: specs/capability-registry.json name=network dag_node=network stratum=S1; tier_subtype retained from absorbed cloud-network / cloud-network-dns service manifests (classify-capability-roots blob 0087b2796)
_stratum_note: S1 from ADR-0562 capability-registry (dag_node network). Replaces the pre-rehome microservice manifest that still cited crates/oya-cloud-network-* dump paths after wave-26 rehome into network/{core,ports,adapters}.
purpose: Network + DNS substrate (ADR-0562 charter): VPC/subnet/LB/DNS-zone domain invariants, residency kernel, provider-neutral OCI/self-hosted command-shaping adapters, VPC/LB/DNS API ports, and transport-profile contract. Cilium/Envoy/CoreDNS cell guardrails are metadata-only in-tree. Apache/OSS Cilium·Envoy·CoreDNS remain transitional data-plane deps behind ports (ADR-0510); no live policy apply, xDS push, CoreDNS deploy, REST server, measured create-API SLI, or audit-chain runtime is claimed by this capability-root slice.

bounded_contexts.name: network-core
bounded_contexts.description: Pure domain and residency kernels under network/core/.

bounded_contexts.name: network-ports
bounded_contexts.description: Provider-neutral API / transport ports under network/ports/.

capability_root_accounting._overlap_note: All eight workspace members under network/{adapters,core,ports} are owned exclusively by this capability root. network/dns carries its own nested sub-manifest (docs/contracts/OpenSLO residual; zero Cargo.toml under network/dns/) and is listed as absorbed, not double-counted in crates_under_capability_root.

contracts.contract_status: openapi+asyncapi+proto present under network/ and network/dns/contracts/; ports expose typed create boundaries without a deployed REST/gRPC server

slo_exemption.rationale: OpenSLO YAML for ADR-0348 autosharding events exists under network/observability/slos/ and is cited in slos[] above. No measured VPC/LB/DNS create-API or data-plane runtime SLI is implemented by the eight local-foundation crates; production traffic SLIs are not claimed by this capability-root slice.
slo_exemption.evidence: verified glob network/observability/slos/**/*.openslo.yaml returns the two autosharding-events files cited in slos[]; no create-API OpenSLO file exists under network/

ips.title: Cilium/Envoy/CoreDNS cell guardrail foundation and Cloud Network manifest truth-down

adrs.title: Service Mesh Istio Ambient And Envoy Gateway

foundation_non_claims: no REST server, SDK crate, worker, Kubernetes controller, Envoy xDS adapter, CoreDNS deployment adapter, Cilium policy apply path, or live data-plane reconciler is implemented by this capability-root slice

no measured create-API SLI, p99 latency, active-active DR, route convergence, DNS query runtime, sharding execution, mesh runtime enforcement, provider lockfile, OpenTofu plan/apply, or capacity telemetry evidence is claimed for Cloud Network runtime

legacy cloud/cloud-network and cloud/cloud-network-dns paths are retired; all eight crates are homed under network/{core,ports,adapters} per ADR-0562 and must not be re-cited from crates/oya-cloud-network-* dump paths in this manifest
explicit_non_claims: OpenSLO files under network/observability/slos/ are the ADR-0348 autosharding-event envelopes cited in slos[]; they are not a claim of measured VPC/LB/DNS create-API or data-plane SLI
network/dns/manifest.json remains a nested absorbed residual and is not restated here; its crate cites must not override the eight in-tree network/* crate homes above
